overlap|PR087.root_cause: Both syllabi use networking-layer vocabulary (layers, protocols, services, virtualisation), so lexical and semantic scores pass the threshold although the subjects differ.
overlap|PR087.fix_or_limitation: Weight matches by distinctive topic terms and require several matched units, not one high course score.

overlap|PR135.root_cause: Only one unit-level topic (rigid-body dynamics) is shared inside otherwise different courses, so the whole-course score stays below the threshold.
overlap|PR135.fix_or_limitation: Report partial overlap from the unit-level detector (best unit pair) instead of the course score.

overlap|PR090.root_cause: One security unit is shared; the rest of each course (IS strategy vs cryptography, IAM) pulls the course score down.
overlap|PR090.fix_or_limitation: Same as above: unit-level evidence for partial overlap.

overlap|PR152.root_cause: Shared statistics topics (hypothesis testing, ANOVA) are phrased differently and sit inside larger, different courses.
overlap|PR152.fix_or_limitation: Unit-level evidence; a domain-adapted encoder for statistics wording.

prerequisite|CIVIL|f48c6dd41|Chemistry (.root_cause: The phrase keeps '(Semester- II)' and the first-year chemistry course has a different name, so neither the name nor the topic match passes.
prerequisite|CIVIL|f48c6dd41|Chemistry (.fix_or_limitation: Strip semester and code annotations from phrases; link common first-year courses to every programme explicitly.

prerequisite|CIVIL|fdb685ff5|Engineering.fix_or_limitation: A small ontology of umbrella subjects mapped to their member courses.

prerequisite|CIVIL|fec17aa83|geography.fix_or_limitation: Classify phrases as subject or background before checking (e.g. the LLM extractor).

redundancy|nm3528490a|nmbb19f1e3.fix_or_limitation: Require overlap of the domain nouns, or a stricter duplicate threshold for design units.
